notes: M18 extends corpus_m17 (byte-identical) with the first REAL, OBSERVED adverse-event propagation chains that are INDEPENDENT of the SAIC<->Torch pair. The observed catalyst is a real, archived Federal Register BIS/Commerce export-control rule (FR 2026-17231, 'Revisions to the Entity List', RIN 0694-AK49, published 2026-08-24) in examples/real_evidence/federal_register_bis_export_controls.json; pyrnova.adverse_events.parse_federal_register_adverse reproduces it and pyrnova.adverse_events.to_regulatory_catalyst emits the catalyst_class=OBSERVED catalyst used here (see tests/test_m18_observed_catalyst.py). The two flagship chains traverse REAL, archived, program-anchored relationship edges grounded by pyrnova.relationships.ground_subaward_edges from examples/real_evidence/usaspending_subawards_torch.json: Parsons Government Services -> Torch (MDA prime award HQ085821C0015) and Intuitive Research & Technology -> Torch (Army prime award W31P4Q23FC001) -- neither is SAIC. Parsons/Intuitive incumbency is established from the authoritative sub-award PRIME fields (relationships.exposed_prime_awards_from_subawards, 0 new calls). The export-control exposure of each prime is INFERRED (missile-defense R&D subject to EAR), so direct threats are MODERATE/MEDIUM and degrade to LOW/LOW one hop downstream -- confidence never increases. Negative discipline (Workstream D/P): the SAME real rule produces NO threat for a company with no evidenced exposure to it, and a REAL single-occurrence (weak) edge terminates propagation. Observed vs modeled catalyst authority is durable on every threat. scoring_v1/fit.py untouched; no fabricated relationships; every hop auditable.

threat_cases.note: NEGATIVE (Workstream D/P). The SAME real observed BIS rule (target EAR:0694-AK49) does NOT threaten a company whose only declared regulation exposure is a DIFFERENT rule -- a real adverse event is never an automatic exposure. NO_EXPOSURE rejection, zero threat, zero propagation. This is the core discipline: a BIS/EAR action requires an evidenced exposure to THAT action.

WEAK-LINK TERMINATION on REAL independent evidence. Same real observed catalyst -> REGULATORY_COMPLIANCE_EXPOSURE on NTSI, LLC (a real MDA prime, HQ085823C0001). NTSI subcontracts Torch on ONE occasion only, so the real NTSI->Torch edge is name_only_weak: the direct threat exists but propagation TERMINATES rather than manufacturing an indirect threat. Independent pair, real weak edge.

threat_cases.note: TEMPORAL TRUTH. The real observed catalyst is published 2026-08-24; evaluated as of 2026-01-01 it is not yet knowable and is excluded, so NO threat and NO rejection arise -- a future adverse event never influences an earlier threat state.

BENEFICIARY side (Workstream J). A real observed export-control threat on an exposed prime opens a substitution opportunity for a competitor holding an explicit SUBSTITUTE_FOR edge (a modeled competitor relationship -- beneficiary edges are not derivable from sub-award evidence). The threatened entity carries the threat; the substitute gets an opportunity, not a threat.

CYCLE PREVENTION invariant on the M18 metrics path. A relationship cycle A<->B is never traversed twice: the threat propagates A->B once, and the B->A edge is refused because A is already on the path. Deterministic, no duplicate.

DUPLICATE-PROPAGATION invariant on the M18 metrics path. A diamond A->B, A->C, B->D, C->D reaches D by two paths; the same (subject, mechanism, root) threat is emitted for D only ONCE -- shared exposure never multiplies into duplicate threats. Uses a HIGH-confidence PROGRAM_CONTRACTION seed so propagation can reach depth 2 (degrading HIGH->MEDIUM->LOW).

PROPAGATED-OUTCOME CALIBRATION begins (Workstream M). A modeled program cancellation threatens an incumbent (direct) and propagates one hop to a dependent subcontractor; BOTH later resolve MATERIALIZED via explicit dated observations. Directional structured outcomes on probe subjects (no real-company future fact asserted). Distinguishes resolved DIRECT from resolved PROPAGATED.
